question: Nowadays, more and more people decide to have children later in their life. What are the reasons? Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is true that women now are showing their increasing preference for delaying motherhood. This could be attributed to multiple factors, which will be analyzed in the essay below, together with the reason why I subscribe to the opinion that this tendency will give rise to many problems.

There are two reasons why women are deemed to become mothers later in life. The most striking one is their greater emphasis on professional and academic advancements by virtue of the influence of modern thoughts and lifestyles. More specifically, they devote themselves to their work and study in pursuit of financial independence, which is very likely that they can provide their children with superior-quality education and healthcare later. Another reason is that thanks to feminist movements which offer respect and protection, women’s social status are progressively recognized. There is a strong likelihood that they are prone to place more importance on their career to hold senior positions in organizations than pay heed to maternal duty, followed by the consideration and reluctance to welcome a new member in their family.

From my perspective, the shift toward later motherhood can induce several challenges for the following reasons. To begin with, It is true that not only the mother but also the baby can stand a higher risk of health issues. The reason is that the mother can suffer from pregnancy or delivery complications such as deformity in baby or premature birth, and in the worst-case scenario, infertility can deprive women of expenses and wellbeing. Futhermore, this shift can act as a culprit of the aging population, which is synonymous with the shortage of young and energetic workforce. It stands to reason that in the absence of young workers, it seems to be an uphill task for technological innovations and economic growth to prosper.

In conclusion, the fact that the decision to have children at later ages is caused by multiple factors. From my point of view, I hold a firm belief that this can put women’s health as well as the social development at stake.
